Standing cross-package rulings applied to every flight (recorded here once): the package whose generated `references/_index.md` lists the governing Zod schema as a core schema is the ANCHOR for that topic; every other package deletes its copy and leaves a one-line pointer; a missing or weaker anchor row is a "follow-up for <package>" line in the PR body, never an edit in another package. Concretely: date macros / filter tokens → objectstack-query; objects / fields / relationships / hooks / seeds / datasources / permissions → objectstack-data; plugin wiring, `os serve` auto-registration, service registry → objectstack-platform; CEL → objectstack-formula; screen flows → objectstack-automation; dataset analytics / `compareTo` → objectstack-ui. Eval stubs, new files, generated-file changes and cross-package growth are deferred to #14296.

Quota note: the maintainer reported the 5-hour window at 79% (reset ≈ 05:53Z); flights 2+ dispatch after flight 1 lands or after the reset, whichever comes first.
